QUOTE: Compile-time macros. Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ... Runtime. Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the compile-time macro pair and the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. It also treats the runtime route as available whenever PLATFORM_MEMORY is on without the macros, which implies a third mode instead of an either/or.
